from throttled import Hook, Throttled, store
seen = []
class LoggingHook(Hook):
    def on_limit(self, call_next, context):
        seen.append(["before", context.key, context.cost, context.algorithm, context.store_type])
        rl = call_next()
        seen.append(["after", "denied" if rl.limited else "allowed", rl.state.remaining])
        return rl
throttle = Throttled(key="/api/users", quota="10/s", hooks=[LoggingHook()], store=store.MemoryStore())
first = res(throttle.limit())
second = res(throttle.limit("/other", cost=10))
third = res(throttle.limit("/other"))
rstore = Throttled(key="r", using="gcra", quota="1/s", hooks=[LoggingHook()], store=redis_store())
rstore.limit()
result = [seen, first, second, third]

from throttled.asyncio import Hook, Throttled, store
class BrokenAfter(Hook):
    async def on_limit(self, call_next, context):
        await call_next()
        raise ValueError("after")
class Counting(Hook):
    def __init__(self):
        self.calls = 0
    async def on_limit(self, call_next, context):
        self.calls += 1
        return await call_next()
counting = Counting()
async def main():
    t = Throttled(key="k", quota="5/m", hooks=[BrokenAfter()], store=store.MemoryStore())
    first = res(await t.limit())
    u = Throttled(key="u", using="gcra", quota="5/m", hooks=[counting], timeout=60,
                  store=store.MemoryStore())
    await u.limit(cost=5)
    waited = res(await u.limit())
    return [first, state(await t.peek("k")), waited, counting.calls, clock.elapsed()]
result = log_lines("throttled.asyncio.hooks", lambda: run(main()))

from opentelemetry.sdk.metrics import MeterProvider
from opentelemetry.sdk.metrics.export import InMemoryMetricReader
from throttled import Throttled, store
from throttled.contrib.otel import OTelHook
reader = InMemoryMetricReader()
meter = MeterProvider(metric_readers=[reader]).get_meter("throttled-example")
throttle = Throttled(key="/api/ping", quota="5/m", hooks=[OTelHook(meter)], store=store.MemoryStore())
flags = ["denied" if throttle.limit("/api/ping").limited else "allowed" for _ in range(6)]
found = {}
for rm in reader.get_metrics_data().resource_metrics:
    for sm in rm.scope_metrics:
        for metric in sm.metrics:
            points = []
            for point in metric.data.data_points:
                attrs = dict(point.attributes)
                amount = getattr(point, "value", None)
                if amount is None:
                    amount = point.count
                points.append([attrs, amount])
            found[metric.name] = [type(metric.data).__name__, metric.unit,
                                  sorted(points, key=lambda p: p[0]["result"])]
result = [flags, found]

from opentelemetry.sdk.metrics import MeterProvider
from opentelemetry.sdk.metrics.export import InMemoryMetricReader
from throttled.asyncio import Throttled, store
from throttled.asyncio.contrib.otel import OTelHook
reader = InMemoryMetricReader()
meter = MeterProvider(metric_readers=[reader]).get_meter("throttled-async")
async def main():
    throttle = Throttled(key="/api/ping", using="fixed_window", quota="5/m", hooks=[OTelHook(meter)],
                         store=store.MemoryStore())
    return [(await throttle.limit()).limited, (await throttle.limit()).limited,
            (await throttle.limit(cost=6)).limited]
flags = run(main())
found = {}
for rm in reader.get_metrics_data().resource_metrics:
    for sm in rm.scope_metrics:
        for metric in sm.metrics:
            total = 0
            keys = set()
            for point in metric.data.data_points:
                total += getattr(point, "value", None) or getattr(point, "count", 0)
                keys.add(tuple(sorted(dict(point.attributes).items())))
            found[metric.name] = [total, sorted(keys)]
result = [flags, found]

from fastapi import FastAPI, Request
from throttled.asyncio.contrib.fastapi import Limiter
from throttled.asyncio import store
limiter = Limiter("1/m", store=store.MemoryStore())
def make_child():
    child = fastapi_app()
    @child.get("/ping")
    @limiter.limit()
    async def ping(request: Request):
        return {"pong": True}
    return child
parent = FastAPI()
parent.mount("/v1", make_child())
parent.mount("/v2", make_child())
client = client_for(parent)
result = [http(client, "GET", "/v1/ping")[:2], http(client, "GET", "/v2/ping")[:2],
          http(client, "GET", "/v1/ping")[:2]]
